posts.text:
I am honored to be endorsed by The Justice Coalition Action.

This political moment calls for bold leadership that is unafraid to speak out against the Israeli government’s genocide of the Palestinian people, take the necessary steps to end our complicity in atrocities overseas, and reshape U.S. policy through the lens of justice and dignity for all.

I'm proud to have their support as we fight for the liberation and self-determination of all people.

SUNDAY JUNE 14TH:

It’s time to fight on!

With just over two months to Election Day, we need all hands on deck!

Join Cori Bush, Rashida Tlaib, and Jamaal Bowman in St. Louis to raise grassroots money to send a true fighter for progressive values and everyday people back to Congress.

Come together with volunteers and supporters in Midtown STL at Luxe Clothing Store on Locust St. to raise funds for Cori as she fights to defeat AIPAC, Big Pharma, ICE contractors, war profiteers, and other right-

Congratulations!! This is amazing!!


Dr. Adam Hamawy (@HamawyForNJ)

New Jersey -- we made history tonight.

Healthcare not bombs.

Abolish ICE.

Unrig the economy.





— https://nitter.net/HamawyForNJ/status/2062025429238579262#m

SUNDAY JUNE 7TH:

Join us for Conversations with Cori at Fifteen Windows Gallery this weekend!

Come chat with Cori and community members in Benton Park West about the issues affecting St. Louis and what’s on your mind heading into the August primary.

The movement is powered by people, and we need to hear from you about your ideas to protect, build, and transform St. Louis.

When: Sunday, June 7th, from 1 PM to 3:30 PM
Where: 3155 Cherokee St, St. Louis, MO 63118
RSVP Here: mobilize.us/coribush1/event/…

Thank you so much to Americans for Justice in Palestine Action for your support as I run to return to Congress and keep fighting to end the genocide in Palestine.

Together, we’ll work to end the apartheid, military occupation, and genocide that is funded by our tax dollars.

Happy Pride Month, St. Louis!

We take this month to celebrate and uplift the LGBTQ+ community here in St. Louis and beyond as we recommit ourselves to continuing to fight for a world where all people are loved and respected for who they are.

Let’s go!! 💙💛


Bosnian Football (@BosniaNTBall)

Former U.S. Representative from Missouri, Cori Bush who is running for U.S. Congress again is organizing a tailgating party for the Bosnia-Herzegovina National Team against Panama in St.Louis. #FIFAWorldCup



— https://nitter.net/BosniaNTBall/status/2061132412294226314#m

We had an amazing time at Salam Day, a community event showcasing and celebrating Salam Scouts!

Salam Scouts started as a group of St. Louis girls who faced down hatred while creating and selling handmade bracelets to support children in Gaza, before growing into a national organization empowering young Muslims to be leaders and advocate for their community. 

I couldn't be more proud to support Salam Scouts and their work to support the Palestinian community both here and overseas.

On Nakba Day, our St. Louis community came together to commemorate 78 years since the occupation of Palestine began.

I will always stand against genocide, even as millions of dollars are spent to scare our movement into silence. Speak out!

Video

We had an amazing evening at the Bashiri Asad Memorial Day celebration!

I always have fun supporting STL’s diverse community of musicians and artists. 

Thank you to the event organizers and to everyone who came out to support independent artists and the creatives of the St. Louis area and beyond.

Yesterday, alongside Mayor Sharon Pace, Northwoods city officials, and community members, I had the honor of celebrating the results of $850,000 in Community Project Funding that my office secured for Northwoods when I represented Missouri’s 1st District.

These funds went to the renovation of Northwoods City Park, upgrading walkways, play areas for children, and other park amenities for local families.

When I return to Congress, I'll keep fighting to bring home the critical funding our neighbo

Thank you Bostel TV St. Louis for inviting me on your show and for talking with me about the issues facing the Bosnian community here in STL.

I’m committed to making sure that St. Louis is a great place to live for all our immigrant communities and fighting back against xenophobia, Islamophobia and all forms of discrimination.

Thank you to everyone who joined us for Conversations with Cori on Sunday afternoon!

I loved hearing from community members from Northwoods and across North County about what you want to see from your leaders and how we can come together to meet this political moment.

If you couldn’t make it, keep an eye out for our next Conversations with Cori! This is a people-powered movement, and we need to come together and organize to build it.
Find our next event here!: mobilize.us/coribush1/

SATURDAY JUNE 6TH:

Join Cori, the team, and supporters at Aloe Plaza to tailgate and cheer on the Bosnia and Herzegovina National Soccer Team as they come to St. Louis to play their last game before the World Cup!

We need help from volunteers like you to make our celebration come together.
RSVP here to volunteer as we table for Cori, engage with the community, and root for the team! mobilize.us/coribush1/event/…
